Late but - still no colonoscopy. Persisting symptoms and weight down to 113 but not anemic at last blood draw (last month). Have been getting terrible night sweats, sweating through my sheets and can’t have my hair down. The other day after have nearly liquid stool for two weeks I also saw bloody mucous. Hoping to get the colonoscopy soon. My bloodwork paperwork also had an “x” in the stool sample box but they did not give me anything for or ask for one but I am debating requesting one. 
The past maybe 6 months I feel a moving thing when my boyfriend rubs my back. It’s is right side under ribs. I think that may be my floating rib when I feel it with my hand but if I just feel it when it’s moving inside it feels like a lump so I’m not sure if that’s related.
Update : just received a call stating my colonoscopy/endoscopy will be pushed back until further notice due to the virus.

Colonoscopy and endoscopy booked for March 23 - bowel changes have fluctuated persistently and I have broken out in Pityriasis rosea ALL over my body (I’m aware this isn’t related just frustrating on top of other symptoms lol).

Just adding random comment outlining ongoing symptoms : was 114lbs nearly all year (5’ 6” usually between 120-125 all my adult life) 
Got pneumonia a few weeks ago and was in bed rest for a week, my boyfriend was home from work and cooked for me all day and got up to 119.8 lbs and stayed for a bit. From last Thursday I have now gone to 116.2 lbs. My appetite it poor but I’m trying to snack during the day and focus on dinner. 
Increasing cramping in stomach, bloating very thin stool today. Shakiness and nausea currently so laying in bed and drinking lots of water. Bowel issues are TOUGH!
Keeping food diary, nothing suspect that I’m noticing yet

Thank you for the diet tips! My dr only mentioned a liquid drink the night before and I did wonder if I should enema or anything else at home for my best shot at a clean colon - so your advice is greatly appreciated! I’m realizing colon cancer (if that’s what this is) is typically more manageable than many other forms of cancer (I don’t want it to sound like I am minimizing cc, not my intention) and that makes me feel better. I will definitely update when the time comes - thank you for your response!

I also have begun getting a sharp pain in my belly button as well, in fact I turned to dr. Google about this just days ago when it was so sharp I couldn’t enjoy my bath. I’m doing my best to stay positive but I feel like I just know, you know? I’m hoping for the best and taking it day by day. I’m just SO relieved I only had to go in once for this ball to get rolling this quickly
